title: Report library test milestones
prompt:
Check the new India library search-triage run for ddk220-light/MyBookshelf-web, PR #188, in /workspace/MyBookshelf-web-india-library-audit (feat/library-connector-audit), docs/research/india-library-audit/search-triage/india-20261108/. Read planning/PARALLEL_RUN_PLAN.md in the parent search-triage directory. Report here whenever another 1,000 distinct libraries have a completed triage_outcome in this new run, and at the final classification checkpoint. Read complete journal lines across every sealed and active segment listed in journal-index.json (or events.jsonl before rollover), verify sealed hashes, and reconcile frozen manifest/progress/CSVs. Do not read only the original events.jsonl after rollover. Do not count retries, individual queries, later book sampling or the 796 offline baseline as newly checked. Initially 5,907 IDs await fresh attempts; report the 796 baseline separately.

Send a plain table by catalog system and total: Working, Needs work (assessed only), Blocked/deferred, pending and Total. Pending is part of category 2 but must not also be included in the assessed Needs work column. Include newly checked/remaining, main blocker reasons and links to per-library/query/result/item CSVs. Show twenty-book sampling only if evidence exists; a Working search is not a twenty-book pass. If multiple thousand milestones passed, combine them into one cumulative report. Use /workspace/library-audit-review/search-triage-reporting-cursor.json to avoid repeats, recording delivered milestones after delivery; keep it separate from collector state. Below thresholds, send no routine update unless an owner-action blocker arises. An unlaunched queue is not stalled.

Read-only reporter: never start/stop/restart providers, edit code/collector files, commit through an active writer or change app sources. Check actual host/PID/command/heartbeat and locks before describing process health. If the workspace is unavailable, use latest pushed branch files and label their timestamp as a checkpoint snapshot, without guessing liveness. Existing old audit/free-knowledge tasks stay paused. This watcher remains enabled through the new run and requested sampling; disable only this watcher after the final validated report is delivered or the owner stops it.
